To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) Algorithm MLS can be modified for computing a pmo, clique tree and minimal separators of a graph; (b) Algorithm MLSM can be used to compute an ato (atom tree) of a graph; and (c) Algorithm MLSM has been used to compute an aco (atom cover of the cliques) for a graph.

we provide a new algorithm for computing a clique tree of a chordal (resp. complement of chordal) graph which runs in linear time, and an algorithm for computing an atom tree of any graph which runs in polynomial time.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of new efficient algorithms for computing the clique minimal separator decompositions and clique trees of graphs, and the clique trees of the complements of graphs, which are useful in many applications.
the computation of a pmo, clique trees and minimal separators of a graph and its complement graph.

a new algorithm for computing a pmo of a graph, a new algorithm for constructing a clique tree of a chordal (resp. a non-chordalic) graph, and an algorithm for constructing an atom tree of a clique minimal separator decomposition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MLSM is a graph search method for chordal graphs which computes the clique minimal separator tree, the clique tree and the clique tree of the dual graph.
algorithm MLS is a very powerful tool to compute clique minimal separator decomposition, clique tree, pmo, atom tree, generators of maximal cliques and generators of minimal separators.

algorithm MLS is the best algorithm for computing a clique tree, a pmo, the minimal separators and the maximal cliques of a chordal or non-chordal (but chordal clique minimal separator decomposable) graph.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the labeling structures for the clique trees of a graph and of its complement are the same, and the labeling structures for a clique tree and for an atom tree of a clique minimal separator decomposition are the same.
algorithm MLS is a very general graph search algorithm which can be used to compute a peo and a clique tree of a chordal (resp. chordal complement) graph and an atom tree for any graph.
algorithm MCS, LexBFP, LexDFS, MNS, and algorithm MLS are all special cases of algorithm MLSM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the labeling structure of the clique tree is a key to understand the clique tree of a graph.
a clique tree can be efficiently computed from the labeling structure, without computing the peo or pmo of the graph.
algorithm MCS is a special case of algorithm MLS, and the clique tree of a graph can be computed by a condition on the labeling of the graph.
